content:
Happy to share that I was among the 𝐓𝐨𝐩 𝟖 𝐚𝐭 𝐂𝐀𝐓𝐀𝐋𝐘𝐒𝐓 𝟑.𝟎, the Startup Law and Policy Summit at CNLU, Patna, organised by the Centre for Innovation Incubation and Legal Entrepreneurship CNLU.

I had the opportunity to present my paper, "𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐁𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐬? 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐭 𝐌𝐞𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐬 𝐌𝐞𝐞𝐭 𝐑𝐁𝐈’𝐬 𝐀𝐜𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐅𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐅𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤”.

The competition was judged by Mr. Arjun Bhagi, Mr. Govinda Toshniwal, Ms. Shruthi Ashok, and Mr. Abhinav Chandra , and it was a privilege to present my paper before such an accomplished panel and learn from their perspectives.

Grateful for the opportunity.
